Added `habit serve`:

- **`src/serve.js`** — starts a plain Node `http` server (no new dependencies), rendering an HTML page with a table of habit names and their current streak (via the existing `currentStreak`), with proper HTML escaping.
- **`src/cli.js`** — wires up `habit serve [port]` (defaults to 3000).
- **`test/serve.test.js`** — tests the empty state, rendered streaks, HTML escaping, and an actual HTTP round-trip.
- **`README.md`** — documents the new command.

All 11 tests pass (`npm test`). I couldn't manually curl the server in this session since compound/backgrounded shell commands need approval that isn't available here, but the automated HTTP test (`serve responds over http`) exercises the real server end-to-end and confirms it works.
